diagnostic.interpretation: Instrumentation contrast, not a noise band or product optimization. Cgroup reads, JSON encoding and cache writes are cocharged to the worker. The shared 20ms sampler can delay disk sampling and free-space reserve checks. Output and snapshot devices can share a physical disk. Five-second points are non-atomic; they provide no phase attribution or peak decomposition.
